faqs.question: Are my files secure?
faqs.answer: Yes, all processing happens in your browser. Your files never leave your device.

faqs.question: What file formats do you support?
faqs.answer: We support PNG, JPG, WebP, TIFF, BMP, and many other image formats.

faqs.question: Is there a file size limit?
faqs.answer: No, you can process images of any size, limited only by your browser's memory.

faqs.question: Do you store my images?
faqs.answer: No, images are processed locally and never stored on our servers.

faqs.question: Can I use it on mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes, PixProMax works on smartphones and tablets.

faqs.question: Is it free?
faqs.answer: Yes, all tools on PixProMax are completely free and always will be.
